task:
Task: `budget::plan` sizes a job's retry schedule from its cost class alone, so a schedule can outlast the window the caller actually has. Give it a second parameter, `deadline_ms: u64` — the wall-clock window the whole schedule must fit inside — and cut attempts until `attempts * backoff_ms <= deadline_ms`, never below one attempt.

Then update every caller to pass the deadline that is right for it. The right value is different at each one, and each module already states its own: read the code around the call rather than picking one number for all of them.

The tests in test.rs specify the behaviour; make them pass.

The change is verified by running: rustc --test --edition 2021 -o t_sig_change.exe test.rs && ./t_sig_change.exe
Make that command exit 0. Do not edit any test files.
